other_conditions: Must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
Must have been a member of the fund for five years
Must have at least 15 years remaining before reaching superannuation/retirement
Must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding year
benefits_summary: Advance loan up to ₹50,000 for house purchase or construction with interest of at least 5% per annum.
